worktree_role: canonical-exec worktree (evidence); feature-extractor worktree for code
never_touch: running GPU cells and their recipes
first_deliverable: CALIBRATION_RULE.json frozen before any computation; then tests (tiny synthetic) red->green; then unattended batch pipeline on worker_b CPU with progress.json; generative_evidence.csv over the 366 denominator
priority: SECONDARY, NON-BLOCKING; fail-closed to NOT_CALIBRATED; never delays the main manifest
generator_decision: conditional heteroskedastic AR with empirical (bootstrap) innovations conditioned only on time encodings (sin/cos hour/dow/doy), observed mask, delta time and past values; numpy/scipy/sklearn only; CVAE NOT RUN (CPU cap <= 3 GB, one seed, exchangeability requirement favours an explicit conditional law)
knockoff_decision: second-order Gaussian group knockoffs (groups = lane B per-fold dependence clusters) built on the generator's standardized innovations with a Gaussian-copula map back to each feature's empirical innovation law; knockoff+ threshold, declared q = 0.10 (matches lane B fdr_q); run only if calibration passes
third_party: knockpy (amspector100) is MIT-licensed (admissible) but is not installed in the worker env and installing into a shared env on a host with a live GPU cell is an environment mutation; implemented in-repo instead
contract: SYNTHETIC_OFFLINE declared; target is NOT used as a generator condition in this run (generator conditions only on information available at t); targets enter only the knockoff selection statistic on TRAIN folds; TEST never read (series/targets npz end at train_end_ts, asserted)
evidence_policy: TRAIN-only inner folds inner_2019..inner_2023 from ps2_batch.v1; fit on fit range, calibration diagnostics on the inner validation range; one seed = 0
compute_policy: worker_b CPU via crispdm-run -m 3G sequential; GPU not requested (5070 Ti shares the 5090 host RAM slice; not needed for a numpy generator)
denominator: 366 features: 269 with series in the three PS2 batches; 10 calendar conditioning (NOT_APPLICABLE); 87 PROVISIONAL_LOW_PRIORITY outside the PS3-C join with no series in any batch (NOT_EVALUATED, knockoff NOT_CALIBRATED)
